Headline: IRGC Navy says three tankers hit mines, catch fire in Strait of Hormuz - state media
Published: Nov 23, 2026, 21:19 GMT
The IRGC Navy said three oil tankers it described as violating maritime restrictions struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz over several hours, causing explosions and fires. One tanker was hit near the southern coast and two east of the strait, while under US military air escort. The IRGC said the escort failed to prevent the incidents and warned that vessels ignoring its instructions would be treated as "cooperating with invading forces." The claims could not be independently verified.
